text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many choices. One key decision is whether to build a native app for one platform or a cross-platform app that works on both iOS and Android. Native apps often perform better, while cross-platform saves time and money. Responsive design matters too, because your app must look good on different screen sizes. After development, you publish your app on app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store. Keep in mind that performance affects user reviews, so testing is essential. A fast, well-designed app keeps users happy and coming back.
